boundaries.notes: Private credentials are intentionally distinct from the public Production publisher and are not connected to a workflow/runtime yet.

invariants: Each Cloudflare token is scoped to exactly one R2 bucket.
No permanent R2 credential is exposed to the browser.
Provisioning a secret does not authorize or prove automatic use.
GitHub is the control plane for CI-operated credentials.
Runtime credentials, if needed later, require a separate explicit decision and minimum privilege.
